verdicts.reason: A and B are the same image as far as I can see. In both, the 'Perfect Taste' wordmark and its gold wreath are shrunk to a tiny centred badge that barely reads on the strip. The photo is cropped to blurry, unrecognisable slices of fig with no tart showing, and the empty left half wastes the left-to-right banner shape, so it looks like a shrunk copy rather than a rearranged design.
